---
name: 💡 Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'triage']
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement

<!-- What problem does this feature solve? What pain point does it address? -->

## Proposed Solution

<!-- A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. -->

## Alternatives Considered

<!-- What other approaches did you consider? Why is this approach better? -->

## Use Cases

<!-- Who would benefit from this feature? In what scenarios? -->

## Example

<!-- If applicable, provide an example of how this feature would work. Screenshots, code snippets, mockups, etc. -->

## Priority

<!-- How important is this feature? -->
- [ ] Critical (blocks production usage)
- [ ] High (significant pain point)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (polish)

## Additional Context

<!-- Any other relevant information. Links to related issues, design discussions, etc. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing feature requests to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have clearly described the problem and proposed solution
- [ ] I have considered alternatives
